title: Habridge (LinuxServer.io)
tagline: Emulates Philips Hue Api to other home automation gateways such as an Amazon Echo/Dot Gen 1 (gen 2 has issues discovering ha-bridge) or other systems that support Philips Hue. The Bridge handles basic commands such as On, Off and brightness commands of the hue protocol. This bridge can control most devices that have a distinct Api.
